The link

  ok    it leads to its store

Who counts as invited

  ok    nor is one of their other stores

  ok    Bea, invited by Ana
  ok    a second invite for Bea does not take her over
  ok    Cal, invited by Ana
  ok    Eve, invited by Dan

Terms stay with the invitation
  ok    new invites snapshot the terms on offer: while the program is paused, the original ones
  ok    legacy records retain their original bonus
  ok    unknown versions are not legacy offers
  ok    invalid stored terms do not earn credit
  ok    fractional bonuses are rejected
  ok    snapshot controls the share

Accepting an invite keeps it; a bad one keeps nothing

  ok    it explains the pause at sign-up
  ok    no new invite cookie is issued
  ok    existing cookies are not overwritten or cleared
  ok    previous acceptances can finish before expiry
  ok    the grace cannot run forever
  ok    invalid clocks cannot grant a referral
  ok    expired grace refuses a new record
  ok    a code nobody has sets nothing

What one payment earns
  ok    half of it, rounded down
  ok    an odd cent is not rounded up
  ok    nothing paid, nothing earned
  ok    a refund comes off first
  ok    so does a credit note

The daily run
  ok    it finished

  ok    Ana: half of Bea's first payment, once
  ok    in dollars
  ok    Bea: her own credit after her first payment

  ok    each request carried its credit's own key

Nothing twice

Later

What Ana sees
